{
  "dataset_name": "blood_transfusion",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "recency_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled months since last donation, compresses long tails for linear margins.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(V1)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth, less skewed recency signal suitable for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "frequency_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled total number of donations.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(V2)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooths frequency distribution; aligns with linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "monetary_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled total blood volume donated (cc).",
      "formula": "np.log1p(V3)",
      "value_range": [5.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes a strongly right-skewed monetary feature for SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "tenure_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled months since first donation (tenure).",
      "formula": "np.log1p(V4)",
      "value_range": [1.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures donor tenure on a stable scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "donations_per_active_month",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Donation frequency normalized by active span (V4 - V1 + 1).",
      "formula": "V2 / np.maximum(V4 - V1 + 1.0, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 22.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous engagement rate; strong linear severity indicator.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_to_tenure_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of tenure represented by recency gap.",
      "formula": "V1 / np.maximum(V4, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized inactivity proxy; near 1 indicates a dormant donor.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "avg_volume_per_donation_dev",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Deviation of per-donation volume from the standard 250 cc unit.",
      "formula": "np.abs(V3 / np.maximum(V2, 1.0) - 250.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 500.0],
      "feature_family": "consistency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Flags data inconsistencies; near zero confirms canonical donation behavior.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "inactivity_gap",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Months between expected donation cadence and current recency.",
      "formula": "V1 - (V4 / np.maximum(V2, 1.0))",
      "value_range": [-50.0, 23.0],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Positive values indicate donor is overdue relative to their own cadence.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_severity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped, normalized recency severity score in [0,1].",
      "formula": "np.clip(V1 / 24.0, 0.0, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded recency feature improving SVM margin stability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "frequency_intensity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized donation count clipped to [0,1].",
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(V2) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded frequency-intensity score aligned with linear weights.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "engagement_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted linear composite: low recency, high frequency and tenure indicate active donor.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(V2) + np.log1p(V4) - np.log1p(V1)",
      "value_range": [-3.5, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Pre-built linear projection that helps SVM margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_loyalty_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic loyalty score blending tenure depth, donation count, and recent activity: higher means the donor has a long, consistent, and recent donation history without relying on supervised signal.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic donor-loyalty signal capturing patterns not expressible as a single ratio.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
